parts.notes: Fig. 8 prints no pin numbers on any gate. Gates lettered in the figure (A, B, C) are mapped to the standard package sections A=1st, B=2nd, C=3rd ...; unlettered gates were assigned to the remaining sections. Gates within a package are interchangeable, so the router may swap them. A,B,C = crystal oscillator and buffer (lettered in figure). D (9->8) = inverter on IC48 pin 12 (article: omitting it shifts the display 4us left); E (11->10) = video output inverter; F (13->12) = Q10 inverter driving pin 13 of the IC44 bank. D/E/F unlettered in figure. Power pins from datasheet.
Crystal from IC28A input to the 22p capacitor.
Series with crystal, to IC28B output / IC28C input. Kit layout has C2 = 27p in this area.
Feedback across IC28A. Probably kit R14 or R15 (470R).
Feedback across IC28B. Probably kit R14 or R15 (470R).

Drawn in two places: dashed box left of IC30 (pins 14, 12: 8MHz -> 4MHz) and dashed box under IC34 (pins 1, 2, 3, 9: B section, clocked by IC34 pin 11, QB pin 9 = B6 -> IC35 pin 14). Pins 2,3 to 0V as drawn. QC (8) and QD (11) not used.
Pin 9 (2MHz) 'To Z80 clock input'. Pin 8 drawn as a stub with no connection. Pin 11 looped to pin 14; pin 12 (250kHz) to IC48 pin 14.
16 states of 4us. Pin 12 looped to pin 1 and to inverter IC28; pin 11 (15.625kHz) clocks IC34 pin 14.

Fig. 8 prints no pin numbers on any gate. Gates lettered in the figure (A, B, C) are mapped to the standard package sections A=1st, B=2nd, C=3rd ...; unlettered gates were assigned to the remaining sections. Gates within a package are interchangeable, so the router may swap them. A (1-3) = NOR(IC28 inverted QA, IC48 pin 9) -> state 0001 decode; B (4-6) = NOR(IC48 pin 8, pin 11) = 'IC31b', low during states 0100-1111, resets IC37/IC38/IC39 and blanks video; C (8-10, unlettered) = inverter Sync -> Sync-bar; D (11-13, unlettered) = MREQ-bar inverter in the CPU write path.

Fig. 8 prints no pin numbers on any gate. Gates lettered in the figure (A, B, C) are mapped to the standard package sections A=1st, B=2nd, C=3rd ...; unlettered gates were assigned to the remaining sections. Gates within a package are interchangeable, so the router may swap them. A (1-3) = NAND(IC31A out, IC31B out) = 4us line-sync pulse (Table 2: 'IC32a out'); B (4-6) = NAND(IC32A out, differentiated field pulse) -> Sync (mixed syncs); C (8-10, unlettered) = NAND(IC33A out, 8MHz) -> 'X' = IC45 pin 1 load and IC38 pin 1 clock; D (11-13, unlettered) = NAND(MREQ, A15) -> IC40-42 pin 1 select and IC49.

Fig. 8 prints no pin numbers on any gate. Gates lettered in the figure (A, B, C) are mapped to the standard package sections A=1st, B=2nd, C=3rd ...; unlettered gates were assigned to the remaining sections. Gates within a package are interchangeable, so the router may swap them. A = 4-input NOR of 0V, IC37 pins 8, 9, 11 (order of the four inputs within the gate arbitrary). B = video gate: NOR of IC31B out, IC34 pin 11 via 'Link', IC36 pin 6, IC45 pin 7; output via IC28 inverter to Video. Strobe inputs (pins 3, 11) are not drawn: left NC (floating TTL input reads high, which enables the gate).
Decade row counter clocked at line rate. 12 looped to 1; 12/9/8 -> IC47 pins 14/15/16; 11 (Q4) -> Link -> IC33B and -> IC29 pin 1. R0 pins 2,3 from monostable IC36 pin 6; R9 pins 6,7 to 0V.
With IC29 B section forms the divide-by-32 character-row counter B6-B10. Pin 11 (B10) also triggers IC36 pin 4.

Figure labels it IC36 74121 (frame monostable). Drawn pins: 1, 4, 6, 10, 11. A1 (3), B (5) and Rint (9) not drawn: left NC (floating A1/B read high, so the B10 falling edge on A2 triggers). Kit layout read this as '7412' - almost certainly 74121.

Drawn as a 2-terminal variable resistor (+5V to IC36 pin 11) labelled '20k multiturn'; no designator printed (VR1 from kit layout). Wiper not drawn separately; see uncertain list. Wiper (3) tied to end 2 so the preset acts as the variable resistor drawn.
IC36 timing capacitor between pin 11 and pin 10. Non-polarised as drawn. Kit layout has C5 270n / C7 220n nearby.
Pull-up on IC36 pin 1 (Q-bar) at the 100n capacitor. Probably kit R118 10k.
Differentiator from IC36 pin 1 to IC32B input.
Differentiator pull-up at IC32B input. Kit layout has R10 = 2k2 in the VDU area.

Figure labels IC37 7492: divide-by-6 character-rate counter clocked at 8MHz on pin 1; 8/9/11 to IC33A. Only reset pin 6 is drawn (from IC31B); R0(2) pin 7 not drawn - left NC (floating high, so pin 6 alone controls reset). QA (12) / CKA (14) unused.
B section only (clock pin 1 from IC32C 'X'); A section (14/12) unused. Reset 2,3 from IC31B with 200p to 0V.
B section only, clocked by IC38 pin 11; A section unused.
From the IC37/IC38/IC39 reset line to 0V.

Pin 1 = 'X' from IC32C; pin 2 = 8MHz; 13/14/3/4/5 from IC47 pins 4/5/6/7/8; pin 6 (H, blank dot) to 0V via dashed link (graphics option); pin 7 (QH-bar) to IC33B; pin 15 to 0V. Pins 9 (QH), 10 (SER), 11 (A), 12 (B) not drawn: NC (A, B, SER never reach the output in a 6-dot cell).
Dashed link with open-circle pads, IC45 pin 6 to 0V. Graphics option replaces it.
Figure labels IC46 7490. Pin 1 'From IC29 pin 12 or 14' (link selects 400 or 800kHz); 11 looped to 14; pin 12 'To IC6 pin 7 clock' (MM57109). QB/QC (9, 8) unused.
Not drawn as a component: figure says 'From IC29 pin 12 or 14'. Modelled as a 3-pad selector link. A (IC29 pin 12, 4MHz) gives 400kHz; B (IC29 pin 14, 8MHz) gives 800kHz.

Figure draws only pins 4-8 (outputs), 10 (0V), 11 (dashed link to 0V), 14-16 (row address from IC34), 17-22 (from video RAM data outputs, table Y/Z: D0->17 ... D5->22, D6 uncommitted). NO supply pins are drawn. Supplies from 2513 datasheet pinout: 1 = VGG (-12V), 12 = VDD (-5V), 24 = VCC (+5V); 2, 3, 9, 13, 23 NC. The board's rails are +5V, -5V, +12V only, so the pin 1 connection must be confirmed (see uncertain).
Dashed link with open-circle pads, IC47 pin 11 (chip enable) to pin 10/0V. Graphics option feeds RAM bit 6 here instead.
Labelled 'Link' in figure: IC34 pin 11 to IC33B input (blanks lines 9 and 10 of each character row). Removed for graphics option.

Figure draws IC40-42 as ONE block: 'All selects and enables wired in parallel', pin 1 select from IC32D (NAND of MREQ and A15), pin 15 to 0V, A inputs = CPU address bus A0-A10, B inputs = counter B0-B10, outputs Q0-Q9 -> 2102 A0-A9, Q10 -> RAM chip-select. A=CPU/B=counter follows from the select polarity (select low during a CPU access selects A). The bit-to-section allocation is NOT given: chosen here as IC40 bits 0-3, IC41 bits 4-7, IC42 bits 8-10 in sections 1-4 order; IC42 section 4 (pins 12-14) spare, left NC. Any consistent permutation is electrically equivalent.

offsheet.label: Video
offsheet.note: output of IC28 (E) inverter; to TV/monitor interface (Fig. 10). No mixing resistors or connector drawn in Fig. 8.

offsheet.label: Sync
offsheet.note: IC32B output, mixed syncs (positive); to TV interface / Fig. 11.

offsheet.label: To Z80 clock input
offsheet.note: IC30 pin 9, 2MHz; goes to the Fig. 2 clock buffer (IC14 / TR1) feeding Z80 pin 6. Fig. 2 arrow is unlabelled; merge by hand.

offsheet.label: To IC6 pin 7 clock
offsheet.note: IC46 pin 12, 400/800kHz to MM57109 (IC6) pin 7 in Fig. 2.

offsheet.label: A15
offsheet.note: from CPU address bus into IC32 (D).

offsheet.label: Address bus A0-A10
offsheet.note: CPU address bus into the A inputs of IC40-42 (expanded).

offsheet.label: Data bus to pins 11 D0-D6
offsheet.note: CPU data bus into video RAM data inputs (pin 11). No read-back path to the CPU is drawn.

offsheet.label: D6 *
offsheet.note: Video RAM bit 6 outputs (IC43g/IC44g pin 12): 'Uncommitted but in for graphics option' - local net with no other connection on this figure.

uncertain: All gate pin numbers (IC28, IC31, IC32, IC33, IC49) are NOT printed in Fig. 8; assigned by gate letter / free sections. Function per gate is certain, pin numbers are a choice.
IC40-42 bit-to-section allocation not drawn (single representative block); allocation chosen (IC40 bits 0-3, IC41 4-7, IC42 8-10, IC42 section 4 spare).

Video RAM letter->bit rule (IC43a/IC44a = D0 ... g = D6) is inferred: Fig. 8 shows only one representative pair; the rule matches the kit layout marking IC43g/IC44g optional (bit 6 = graphics bit that 'may be omitted'). Fig. 6 main memory uses the opposite order (a = D7), so confirm against the board.
21L02 address pins: figure says only 'Q0-Q9 to A0-A9 of 2102'; mapped by datasheet. Any permutation works electrically as long as all 14 chips are identical.

IC47 2513 supply pins are not drawn at all. Datasheet: pin 1 VGG = -12V, pin 12 VDD = -5V, pin 24 VCC = +5V. The board has only +5V/-5V/+12V (Part 3 PSU test), so pin 1's real connection on the kit (maybe -5V) must be checked; -12V left as a deliberately unmatched net.
VR1 wiper: drawn as a 2-terminal variable resistor; pin 3 (wiper) left NC. A 3-pin preset would normally have its wiper tied to one end (e.g. pin 2).
Floating TTL inputs as drawn: IC33 strobes (3, 11), IC36 A1/B (3, 5), IC37 R0(2) (7), IC45 SER/A/B (10-12). Electrically they read high and the circuit works, but a PCB may want them tied to +5V.
IC46 pin 1 link (IC29 pin 12 or 14) is only a text note in the figure; modelled as 3-pad LINK_VDU3.
No sync/video mixing resistors appear in Fig. 8 (only separate Video, Sync, Sync-bar outputs). The kit's VDU-area resistors (R119 1k8, R120, R10 2k2, C5 270n) are not on this figure.

Passive values differ from kit layout: osc capacitor 22p (kit C2 27p), differentiator 2k7 (kit R10 2k2?), timing cap 220n (kit C5 270n or C7 220n?). Figure values used; refs R_VDUn/C_VDUn are placeholders, since the figure prints no designators.
